exposure: timing of labor induction with vaginal dinoprostone (within 6 hours after PROM)
timing of labor induction with vaginal dinoprostone (within 6-24 hours after PROM)
outcome: duration from induction of labor to vaginal delivery
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with term prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM) and an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score < 6) who underwent labor induction with vaginal dinoprostone.
finding: Induction of labor with vaginal dinoprostone within 6 hours of prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM) was associated with a lower cesarean delivery rate and less nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracing compared to induction within 6-24 hours.
mod_finding: Induction within 6 hours of PROM significantly lowered the cesarean delivery rate compared to induction within 6-24 hours.
